1. **Same-filesystem publication stage** (`src/recorder/paths.ts`, `src/recorder/run.ts`): stage allocated under archive-ignored `.ak/work/recorder-stage-*` with device identity checks; raw tee scratch remains outside worktree (tmpdir) and is required-removed before promote.
2. **Create-if-absent promotion**: exclusive `mkdir(dest)` claim (no symlink follow on final name), entry rename with `manifest.json` last, claim removed on every failure path; pre-existing/child-created destinations and destination symlinks rejected without overwrite/follow. Marker-file check-then-rename protocol removed.
3. **Failure law preserved**: Recorder infrastructure failures return 125 with one scanned JSON line after already-teed child stderr; successful child exit/signal preserved after publication; child signal + Recorder failure yields 125 (not re-raised signal).
